h2: We cannot wait to see you!
p: We invite you to share in our joy. The adventure begins on the second of January.

One college. Two hearts. Countless memories. One big decision to annoy each other for the rest of our lives. What began on campus is now leading us to the altar, and we couldn't be happier about our favorite plot twist. Come along and Join us!
We have planned every hour to be full of joy. Here is how the day will unfold.
Guests arrive and find their seats in the garden for the ceremony.
The ceremony begins with the couple taking the stage with rituals
The wedding ceremony is completed its main course
Lunch is served in the main hall with all friends, family and relatives
Photo session with bride and groom starts
Starts at 6:00 PM at Groom's native, location provided below
Thank you for being part of our story. The day would not be the same without you.
